belter-miner.name: Belter miner
offer: Take {give}, give me {get}. A Belter's word is as good as the rock he stands on.
I've got {get} going spare. You've got {give}. Seems like destiny, or arithmetic.
accept: Done. Don't tell the others how little I asked.
Fair enough. Shake, and mind the gloves.
decline: No. I've seen better offers from a rock.
Not for that. Try again with more manners.

lane-clerk.name: Lane Authority clerk
offer: The Authority will accept {give} in exchange for {get}. Form 9 is optional, which means mandatory.
I may release {get} for {give}. Please do not mention this.
accept: Approved. Stamp is on the left.
Noted. Filed. Forgotten.
decline: Denied. The form says so.
I cannot accept that. I could, but I would have to sign something.

tug-captain.name: Tug captain
offer: I'll swap {get} for {give}. The tow is still extra.
{give} for {get}. My ship eats credits, so spare me the haggle.
accept: Good deal. The tug and I thank you.
Done. I'll put it on the invoice anyway.
decline: Not worth my fuel.
No. The tug has opinions, and they match mine.

hydroponics-widow.name: Hydroponics widow
offer: Bring me {give} and I'll part with {get}. Henry would have said no. Henry is not here.
{get} for {give}. The tomatoes have been lonely.
accept: Wonderful. Mind the leaves.
Deal. Henry would have approved, mostly.
decline: Not today, dear. I need more than that.
No. I have survived worse offers.

depot-chandler.name: Depot chandler
offer: I'll trade {get} for {give}. Prices are firm. My knees are not.
{give} gets you {get}. Don't read the small print. It is blank.
accept: Sold. Receipt is in the drawer. The drawer is stuck.
A fine trade. Come again.
decline: No. I did not get this fat on bad deals.
The scale says no, and the scale is honest.

refinery-foreman.name: Refinery foreman
offer: I'll part with {get} for {give}. The fumes are free.
{get} for {give}. Take it before the boss sees.
accept: Done. Wipe your boots.
Deal. Try not to light anything.
decline: No. The shift ended two hours ago.
That won't cover the fumes.

ice-priest.name: Ice-moon priest
offer: The Lord provides {get}. The Lord asks {give}. The Lord is fair.
A blessing and {get}, for {give}. The blessing is a courtesy.
accept: Bless you. Truly.
Go in peace, and with parts.
decline: The Lord is not moved. I am even less so.
Pray on it. Then come back with more.

salvage-dealer.name: Salvage dealer
offer: Found {get} in a wreck. Won't say whose. Trade me {give} and we forget it.
{get} for {give}. The previous owner will not be needing it.
accept: Done. No questions. No receipts.
Pleasure. Don't ask about the dent.
decline: No. I pulled that off a wreck. I want more.
Walk on. The wreck will find someone else.

ration-trader.name: Ration trader
offer: I carry {get}. You carry {give}. We should be friends.
{give} for {get}. It is a fair price. For me.
accept: Splendid. Eat well.
Done. Nobody starved today.
decline: No. I have a family and a ledger.
Too thin. Fatten the offer.

drive-mechanic.name: Drive mechanic
offer: I'll hand over {get} if you hand over {give}. Quick. The grease is drying.
{get} for {give}. The part works. Probably.
accept: Done. Don't thank me, thank the wrench.
Good. Bolt it in, say a word.
decline: No. That would not fix a toaster.
Not enough. I have a crew to feed and a spanner to blame.

beacon-hermit.name: Beacon hermit
offer: It's been a while. I have {get}. Do you have {give}?
{give} for {get}. I have not seen a trade in years. Please be kind.
accept: Oh. Oh, good. Thank you.
Yes. Thank you. It has been quiet.
decline: No. I'll just sit here, then.
Not this time. The dark is patient.

settler-veteran.name: Veteran settler
offer: I made the trip in '81. {get} for {give} and I'll throw in a warning.
{give} for {get}. You'll need it more than I do.
accept: Good. You'll do fine. Probably.
Done. Keep your head down on the last leg.
decline: No. I paid too much for it myself.
Not for that. I earned this the hard way.

dock-kid.name: Dockside kid
offer: Hey. {get} for {give}? Mum said to ask for more.
Got {get}. Want it for {give}? Don't tell Mum.
accept: Wow. Thanks!
Deal. I'll tell Mum I drove a hard bargain.
decline: Mum says no.
I have to ask my sister.

smooth-stranger.name: Smooth stranger
offer: Friend, I have {get}. You have {give}. It's a sign. Do not look at the sign closely.
A rare chance: {get} for {give}. Nobody has complained. Yet.
accept: Pleasure. Count it later. Much later.
You're a sharp one. Run along.
decline: Oh well. Your loss, friend.
No? Then I have not met you.
